move: 3D hand enters, taps a swatch, presses button, button squashes, ring ripples
how: A three.js scene (procedural capsule hand: palm, four curled fingers, extended index, thumb, wrist, MeshStandardMaterial skin) renders on a transparent canvas over a DOM product card. A title rises masked and the card rises from y 300 / scale 0.9 (expo.out). A pose object (x, y, z, press, rz) is tweened: the hand glides from bottom-right to the blue swatch (expo.out 1.1s), dips z 3→0.6 with the index curling (press 1) for a 0.18s tap, and a call() switches the active swatch and price while the swatch scales 0.85 yoyo. It then moves to the button (expo.inOut 0.9s) and presses; the button scales 0.94 then elastic.out(1,0.4) back, the label reads 'Added ✓', a ring ripples scale 0.5→6 fading, and the card dips y -12 with an elastic settle. At 73% the hand retreats off-frame with power3.in; the title and card leave at 88-92% and swatch/price reset. The seek() callback seeks the GSAP timeline, applies the pose to the hand, adds a sin/cos idle sway from t, and renders.
adapt: Replace the card copy, swatch colours, prices and button label, and the yellow ground; the world-space targets are computed from DOM pixel positions via toWorld(), so move the swatch/button and update those two coordinates; keep the 0.18s tap dip and the 0.9s travel.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the card and a canvas sized to el, creates the renderer/scene/hand and the pose object; animate(el, shot, D) returns the GSAP timeline plus a tween with onUpdate that sets the hand from pose, applies the idle sway from the timeline's time, and calls renderer.render (replacing the fx.register seek loop). toWorld() assumes a 1080x1920 canvas and fov 35 at z 30, so recompute vh/vw from el's size; the call()s for swatch/price/label must be el-scoped.
caveats: fx.register seek loop must become a tween with onUpdate on the returned timeline
assumes a 1080x1920 viewport for the DOM-to-world mapping
WebGL canvas with preserveDrawingBuffer overlays the DOM
swatch, price and button label are changed via call() and can go stale when scrubbing backwards
the hand is a stylised procedural mesh, not a modelled hand
